هذا المستند يبين خطوات الفحص الشهرى لجهاز التنفس الصناعى شكل 
 رقم 8 كما 
 هو مبين اعلاة بالرمز 
 م1
اعد المسودة الأولية لهذا المستند الطبيب / على 
 صابر محمد وتم الاختبار بمعرفة مشرف فنى السلامة والصحة المهنية/ جمال ذكى 
 صبح وموافقه السيده المهندسه/ سوسن محمد الليثى مدير اداره المحطه وبمراجعة 
 كل من السيد المهندس/ عبد المنعم عطيه الامام والسيد المهندس/ مدحت خاطر 
 بقطاع التفتيش ومراقبه الجودة وموافقه السيد المهندس/ سمير عبد الجليل 
 مدير عام التفتيش الفنى ومنسق MPIS واعتماد 
 السيد المحاسب/محمود سليمان رئيس قطاع 
 التخطيط 
 والتنببؤ المالى والمشرف على قطاع 
 التفتيش ومراقبه الجوده

إصدار أمر شغل مع حمل العاملين بالموقع كارت فئة 
السلامة والصحة المهنية

تسوير مكان 
العمل ووضع لافتات التحذيرية المناسبة

مهمات السلامة والصحة المهنية مثل خوذة 
أمان وحزام أمان 000الخ
تأكد أم كل الأجزاء نظيفة وسليمة 0

تأكد
 من 
 وضع حزام الكتف وأنة غير ضاغط على الأكتاف وان الأنبوبة الممتلئة موضوعة بأمان 
 على لوح الظهر, وإذا وجدت الأنبوبة فارغة غيرها
تأكد أن الحزام يتحرك بحرية داخل الإبزيم 0

تأكد أن الجزء الشفاف الامامى لماسك الوجه نظيف 
 وليس بة علامات تعوق الرؤية الواضحة وسليم من اى شروخ , وأرخى حزام الرأس

إذا 
 وجد اى عيوب فى النقاط االاربعة السابقة اتبع إرشادات الصيانة فى SIGMA 2 Service Manual

تأكد أن وصلة الأنبوبة الدائرية نظيفة 
 وسليمة

اربط هذه الوصلة بإحكام مع مخرج صمام 
 الاسطوانة

تأكد أن مقياس الضغط والخراطيم فى حالة جيدة 
 وغير مثنية أو مشدودة
تأكد أن وصلة الصمام الدائرية نظيفة وسليمة

ثبت صمام الطلب الي ماسك الوجه وتأكد أن الوصلة 
 دخلت فى مكانها السليم وبخفة ودون عنف ادر الصمام لتتأكد 
 انه مثبت بأمان

تأكد أن الصمام الجانبى ( الاضافى ) مغلق ( اى أن 
 الجزء المسطح على المفتاح ناحية الوجه )

فى حالة استعمال صمام طلب يعمل مع أول نفس , اضغط 
 على الزر الأسود كما ذكرنا سابقاً
افتح صمام الأنبوبة وتأكد أنها مملؤة

تأكد أن ماسك الوجه يصلة ضغط إذا احتجت اضبط 
 الماسك لمنع التسرب ولكن لاتربط الحزام أكثر من اللازم لان ذلك يتلف الماسك

ضع إصبعين تحت حافة الماسك وتأكد من سريان 
 الهواء بانتظام خارج الماسك
اخرج إصبعيك لتترك الماسك يعود لوضعه

افتح الممر الاضافى ( الجانبى ) وتأكد أن 
 الهواء يسرى بانتظام الي الماسك

أغلق صمام الأنبوبة , اكتم نفسك , راقب 
 مقياس الضغط 10 ثوانى وتأكد أن قراءة الضغط لم تنزل خلال هذه الفترة (10 ث)

بينما صمام الاسطوانة لايزال مغلقاً تابع 
 مقياس الضغط وانفخ هواء زفير فى الجهاز وتأكد أن صوت الصفارة يصدر بوضوح عند 
 ضغط بين 50 ـ 60 بار

الجهاز الذي اجتاز كل تلك الاختبارات يعتبر 
 معد للاستخدام

تأكد أن صمام مغلق , ثم تعامل ببطء لفك وصلة 
 الاسطوانة قم بإزالة المقلل 
 ( 4.2 
 ) 
 من الاسطوانه

اسحب إبزيم غلق الكمامة بإصبع السبابة 
 والإبهام لليد اليمنى , واستخدم السبابة اليسرى لتدفيع المزلاج المدعم وتدفيع 
 الابرزيم

افتح الإبزيم واحمل الاسطوانة الفارغة من 
 على لوح الظهر
تثبيت الاسطوانة البديلة من نفس الحجم
ثبت صمام الاسطوانة فى مكانة , ووصل حامل الإبزيم وأغلق الكمامة

اضبط حزام الاسطوانة وطوله ليسمح بوصل حامل 
 الإبزيم

لاتغلق الكامة الأبعد التأكد من مناسبة هذا 
 الطول

رتب مكان للنهاية الحرة لحزام الاسطوانة 
 بحيث لا يتدلى

البولي إيثيلين المكلور، النتريل المقوى لضفيرة القماش 
 بطانة
PTCFE liner, stainless steel braiding. Estane sleeve

 polyettylene grid with anodised aluminium coating

SIGMA-2 with facemask 
69 x 41 x 28 cm 5.0 kg

EN 137 Open circuit self contained 
compressed air breathing apparatus

EN 136 Full facemasks for respiratory 
protective devices

Compact positive pressure demand valve featuring servo-assisted, tilting 
diaphragm mechanism with low inspiratory resistance and responsive dynamic 
performance, instant positive pressure and hands free bypass facility. 
Components injection moulded from polyamide and acetal with rubber seals and 
diaphragms

أداء تدفق الذروة: - 
ما يزيد عن 500 لتر / دقيقة

The high pressure cylinder connector and first stage pressure reducing valve 
are integrated.
The cylinder connector features a universal 200 or 300 bar handwheel connection 
and incorporates a sintered bronze particulate filter (30-40 microns) The 
pressure reducer features a non-adjustable, spring loaded piston mechanism and 
outlet supply protected by pressure relief valve

Valve body and cap machined from nickel plated brass with stainless steel 
spring and hose retaier U-clips

Flow restrictor to gauge supply hose < 25 liters 
minute

مؤشر الاتصال الهاتفي من نوع أنبوب بوردون
Heat and impact resistant polycarbonate lens
Safety blow - out vent in rear of gauge
Photo-luminescent face
الدقة: +/- 10 بار بين 40 - 300 بار
Whistle: 55 bar
تركيبات خرطوم دوارة من الفولاذ المقاوم للصدأ.

خرطوم الضغط المتوسط:
Maximum working pressure 16 bar
Minimum burst pressure 80 bar

High pressure hose:
Maximum working pressure 450 bar
الحد الأدنى لضغط الانفجار 800 
شريط

The Sabre Panaseal positive pressure facemask is has non-dermatitic neoprene 
inner and outer mask materials, a scratch and impact resistant polycarbonate 
visor and a five point rubber headharness. The mask also features a front 
mounted speech diaphragm, with a side mounted demand valve for reduced profile 
and unimpeded speech transmission. The positive pressure exhalation valve has an 
operating pressure 4.4 and 6.0 m bar. The mask also accepts integrated spectacle 
frames with out compromising the facemask seal.

rows: Issued to: Port Said Gas Power Station

This document sets out the steps for the monthly inspection of the Sigma 2 industrial breathing apparatus, Figure No. 8, as shown above with symbol M1. The first draft of this document was prepared by Dr. Ali Saber Mohamed, tested by Occupational Safety and Health Technical Supervisor Gamal Zaki Sobh, approved by Eng. Sawsan Mohamed El-Leithy, Station Manager, reviewed by Eng. Abdel Monem Attia El-Imam and Eng. Medhat Khater of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector, approved by Eng. Samir Abdel Galil, General Manager of Technical Inspection and MPIS Coordinator, and approved by Accountant Mahmoud Soliman, Head of the Financial Planning and Forecasting Sector and Supervisor of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector.
Issue a work order, with the site workers carrying the appropriate Occupational Safety and Health category card
Fence off the work area and put up the appropriate warning signs
Occupational safety and health equipment such as a safety helmet and safety belt, etc.
Make sure that all parts are clean and sound
Make sure the shoulder strap is positioned so that it does not press on the shoulders and that the full cylinder is safely placed on the backplate; if the cylinder is found empty, replace it
Make sure the strap moves freely inside the buckle
Make sure the transparent front part of the facemask is clean, has no marks obstructing clear vision and is free of any cracks, and loosen the head strap
If any defects are found in the four points above, follow the maintenance instructions in the SIGMA 2 Service Manual
Make sure the cylinder circular connection is clean and sound
Connect this connection tightly to the cylinder valve outlet
Make sure the pressure gauge and hoses are in good condition and are not bent or stretched
Make sure the valve circular connection is clean and sound
Fit the demand valve to the facemask and make sure the connection has entered its correct place; gently and without force turn the valve to make sure it is securely fixed
Make sure the side (additional) valve is closed (i.e. the flat part on the switch is towards the face)
If using a demand valve that operates on the first breath, press the black button as mentioned above
Open the cylinder valve and make sure it is full
Make sure the facemask receives pressure; if necessary adjust the mask to prevent leakage, but do not tighten the strap more than necessary as this damages the mask
Place two fingers under the edge of the mask and make sure air flows steadily out of the mask
Remove your fingers to let the mask return to its position
Open the additional (side) passage and make sure the air flows steadily to the mask
Close the cylinder valve, hold your breath, watch the pressure gauge for 10 seconds and make sure the pressure reading does not fall during this period (10 s)
While the cylinder valve is still closed, watch the pressure gauge and exhale air into the apparatus, and make sure the whistle sounds clearly at a pressure between 50 and 60 bar
Remove the head strap and facemask
An apparatus that has passed all these tests is considered ready for use
Make sure the valve is closed, then slowly undo the cylinder connection and remove the reducer (4.2) from the cylinder
Pull the mask closing buckle with the index finger and thumb of the right hand, and use the left index finger to push the reinforced latch and push the buckle
Open the buckle and carry the empty cylinder off the backplate
Fitting a replacement cylinder of the same size
Fit the cylinder valve in its place, connect the buckle holder and close the mask
Fitting a cylinder of a different size
Adjust the cylinder strap and its length to allow the buckle holder to be connected
Do not close the cam until you have made sure this length is suitable
Arrange a place for the free end of the cylinder strap so that it does not hang down

This document sets out the steps for the monthly inspection of the Sigma 2 industrial breathing apparatus, Figure No. 8, as shown above with symbol M1. The first draft of this document was prepared by Dr. Ali Saber Mohamed, tested by Occupational Safety and Health Technical Supervisor Gamal Zaki Sobh, approved by Eng. Sawsan Mohamed El-Leithy, Station Manager, reviewed by Eng. Abdel Monem Attia El-Imam and Eng. Medhat Khater of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector, approved by Eng. Samir Abdel Galil, General Manager of Technical Inspection and MPIS Coordinator, and approved by Accountant Mahmoud Soliman, Head of the Financial Planning and Forecasting Sector and Supervisor of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector.
Safety Precautions
Issue a work order, with the site workers carrying the appropriate Occupational Safety and Health category card | 
Fence off the work area and put up the appropriate warning signs |

Occupational safety and health equipment such as a safety helmet and safety belt, etc. |

Procedure to be Carried Out
Before Use
General Instructions
Make sure that all parts are clean and sound | 1.
Make sure the shoulder strap is positioned so that it does not press on the shoulders and that the full cylinder is safely placed on the backplate; if the cylinder is found empty, replace it | 2.
Make sure the strap moves freely inside the buckle | 3.
Make sure the transparent front part of the facemask is clean, has no marks obstructing clear vision and is free of any cracks, and loosen the head strap | 4.
If any defects are found in the four points above, follow the maintenance instructions in the SIGMA 2 Service Manual | 5.
Pneumatic equipment, Figure No. 1
Make sure the cylinder circular connection is clean and sound | 1.
Connect this connection tightly to the cylinder valve outlet | 2.
Make sure the pressure gauge and hoses are in good condition and are not bent or stretched | 3.
Demand valve, Figures No. 2, 3
Make sure the valve circular connection is clean and sound | 1.
Fit the demand valve to the facemask and make sure the connection has entered its correct place; gently and without force turn the valve to make sure it is securely fixed | 2.
Make sure the side (additional) valve is closed (i.e. the flat part on the switch is towards the face) | 3.
If using a demand valve that operates on the first breath, press the black button as mentioned above | 4.
Facemask condition – see section (4.2)
Open the cylinder valve and make sure it is full | 1.
Make sure the facemask receives pressure; if necessary adjust the mask to prevent leakage, but do not tighten the strap more than necessary as this damages the mask | 2.
Positive pressure test, Figures No. 4, 5
Place two fingers under the edge of the mask and make sure air flows steadily out of the mask | 1.
Remove your fingers to let the mask return to its position | 2.
Open the additional (side) passage and make sure the air flows steadily to the mask | 3.
Close the cylinder valve, hold your breath, watch the pressure gauge for 10 seconds and make sure the pressure reading does not fall during this period (10 s) | 4.
Whistle test, Figure No. 6
While the cylinder valve is still closed, watch the pressure gauge and exhale air into the apparatus, and make sure the whistle sounds clearly at a pressure between 50 and 60 bar | 1.
Remove the head strap and facemask | 2.
An apparatus that has passed all these tests is considered ready for use | 3.
Replacing the cylinder, Figure No. 7
Make sure the valve is closed, then slowly undo the cylinder connection and remove the reducer (4.2) from the cylinder | 1.
Pull the mask closing buckle with the index finger and thumb of the right hand, and use the left index finger to push the reinforced latch and push the buckle | 2.
Open the buckle and carry the empty cylinder off the backplate | 3.
Fitting a replacement cylinder of the same size
Fit the cylinder valve in its place, connect the buckle holder and close the mask | 1.
Fitting a cylinder of a different size
Adjust the cylinder strap and its length to allow the buckle holder to be connected | 1.
Do not close the cam until you have made sure this length is suitable | 2.
Arrange a place for the free end of the cylinder strap so that it does not hang down | 3.

Major Components Sigma - 2
Demand Valve
Compact positive pressure demand valve featuring servo-assisted, tilting diaphragm mechanism with low inspiratory resistance and responsive dynamic performance, instant positive pressure and hands free bypass facility. Components injection moulded from polyamide and acetal with rubber seals and diaphragms
Peak flow performance: over 500 litres / minute
Bypass flow: 150 liters / minute nominal
Static positive pressure: 1.8 - 3.5 mbar
Pressure reducing valve
The high pressure cylinder connector and first stage pressure reducing valve are integrated. The cylinder connector features a universal 200 or 300 bar handwheel connection and incorporates a sintered bronze particulate filter (30-40 microns) The pressure reducer features a non-adjustable, spring loaded piston mechanism and outlet supply protected by pressure relief valve
Valve body and cap machined from nickel plated brass with stainless steel spring and hose retaier U-clips
Outlet pressure
207 bar inlet: 5.5 to 9.5 bar
300 bar inlet: 6.0 to 11.0 bar
Pressure relief valve protected: 11.5bar
Flow restrictor to gauge supply hose < 25 liters minute
Pressure indicator & warning whistle
Bourdon tube dial indicator. Heat and impact resistant polycarbonate lens. Safety blow-out vent in rear of gauge. Photo-luminescent face. Accuracy: +/- 10 bar between 40 - 300 bar. Whistle: 55 bar
Hoses
Stainless steel swivel hose fittings.
Medium pressure hose: Maximum working pressure 16 bar. Minimum burst pressure 80 bar
High pressure hose: Maximum working pressure 450 bar. Minimum burst pressure 800 bar
Pana-seal positive pressure facemask
The Sabre Panaseal positive pressure facemask is has non-dermatitic neoprene inner and outer mask materials, a scratch and impact resistant polycarbonate visor and a five point rubber headharness. The mask also features a front mounted speech diaphragm, with a side mounted demand valve for reduced profile and unimpeded speech transmission. The positive pressure exhalation valve has an operating pressure 4.4 and 6.0 m bar. The mask also accepts integrated spectacle frames with out compromising the facemask seal.
